strings.name: António Costa
strings.summary: Costa moved from law and local politics to justice minister, Lisbon mayor and Portuguese premier in 2015–2024. He resigned amid an investigation in 2023, denying wrongdoing, and remained caretaker until April 2024. European Council president since December 2024, he coordinates EU leaders. In 2026 prosecutors still described him as a suspect without formal arguido status.
